create_app_config_from_env: create an AppConfig instance from environment variables using AppConfig.from_env()
setup_cache_mongo_resource: setup a CacheMongoResource with a database name and mongo URL host
setup_queue_mongo_resource: setup a QueueMongoResource with a database name and mongo URL host
init_libraries_resource: init a LibrariesResource with an hf_endpoint, datasets cache path, and numba path
clean_cache_and_queue_databases: clean the cache and queue MongoDB databases using _clean_cache_database and _clean_queue_database
